description: Use this when someone asks about one hotel's setup, such as its default check-in and check-out times, currency, country or timezone. Returns the hotel's name, currency, language, timezone, country code and default check-in and check-out times, or not-found. Not for room availability or prices.
name: get_hotel

hotel.description: Operational hotel metadata; null when not found. Contact details, addresses, integrations, credentials, payment configuration, reminders and guest data are never returned.

title: Get hotel details

description: Use this when someone asks if rooms are free for certain dates or what a stay would cost. Returns the room types and rate plans with a free room every night for the party, with rooms left and nightly and total prices in minor currency units. Stays of 1–30 nights, check-in within 365 days. Not for making a booking.

adults.description: Adults staying, from 1 to 20; defaults to 2

checkInDate.description: Arrival date as YYYY-MM-DD, from today to 365 days ahead in the hotel's timezone

checkOutDate.description: Departure date as YYYY-MM-DD, 1 to 30 nights after checkInDate

children.description: Children staying, from 0 to 20; defaults to 0

infants.description: Infants staying, from 0 to 20; defaults to 0

name: get_hotel_availability

offers.description: One row per bookable room type and rate plan with a free room every night. Amounts are integer minor currency units (12000 is 120.00 in a two-decimal currency). Guest records, reservations, room assignments, access data, notes, payments, channel references, photos, free-text descriptions and credentials are excluded.

offersAreTruncated.description: True when more than 100 offers matched the search

title: Check room availability and prices

description: Use this when someone asks how busy the hotel is, or how many arrivals, departures or in-house stays fall on each day. Returns daily counts of confirmed, checked-in and checked-out stays plus reservation totals by status, for 7 days from today by default and at most 31 days; counting stops at 500. Not for looking up a guest or reservation.

dateFrom.description: First day as YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive); defaults to today in UTC

dateTo.description: Last day as YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive), at most 31 days in total; defaults to six days after dateFrom

name: get_hotel_schedule_summary

days.description: One row per day. arrivals, departures and inHouseReservations count confirmed, checked-in and checked-out stays; a stay is not in-house on its checkout day. Reservation or allocation identifiers, individual stay records, guest data, room assignments, notes, documents, payments, access data, channel references and credentials are never returned.

reservationCountIsLowerBound.description: True when more than 500 reservations overlap the range

statusCounts.description: Reservations overlapping the range by status, inquiries, requests, no-shows and cancellations included

title: Count arrivals, departures and stays

description: Use this when someone asks about one room type, such as its name or how many guests it sleeps. Returns the room type's name, hotel and maximum guests, or not-found. Not for its prices or free dates.

roomTypeId.description: Room type id: 24 lowercase hexadecimal characters

name: get_room_type

roomType.description: Null when not found. Free-text descriptions, facilities, photos, channel mappings, integrations, credentials and arbitrary metadata are never returned.

title: Get room type details

description: Use this when someone asks what a rate costs on specific nights, or about minimum stays, stop-sell or closed-to-arrival dates. Returns the stored per-day price and restrictions of one rate plan over up to 90 days; days without a row use the plan's base price. Not for whether rooms are free.

dateTo.description: Last night as YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive); the range covers at most 90 days

ratePlanId.description: Rate plan id, belonging to hotelId: 24 lowercase hexadecimal characters

name: list_daily_rates

dailyRates.description: Stored per-day rows sorted by date; a date without a row sells at the plan's base price. price is in integer minor currency units. Guest, payment, channel, credential and arbitrary metadata are excluded.

title: Show daily prices and restrictions

description: Use this when someone asks what extras a hotel sells, such as breakfast, parking, spa, transfers or fees, and what they cost. Returns each active extra's name, price in minor currency units, currency, category and taxable flag, 20 per page by default. Not for what a guest bought or was charged.

hotelId.description: Only this hotel (24 lowercase hexadecimal characters); every hotel when absent

limit.description: Extras per page, from 1 to 100; defaults to 20

offset.description: Extras to skip, from 0 to 10000; defaults to 0. For the next page pass offset + limit

name: list_extras

extras.description: Active extras; price is in integer minor currency units. Guest charges, folio data, display colors and credentials are excluded.

category.description: BREAKFAST, PARKING, SPA, TRANSFER, FEE or OTHER

page.description: hasMore is true when another page exists; request it with offset + limit

title: List extras and add-ons

description: Use this when someone asks which hotels or properties they manage in Hotelumo, or a hotel's id is needed. Returns each hotel's id, name, currency, language and timezone, 20 per page by default (no addresses or guest data). Not for room availability.

limit.description: Hotels per page, from 1 to 100; defaults to 20

offset.description: Hotels to skip, from 0 to 10000; defaults to 0. For the next page pass offset + limit

name: list_hotels

hotels.description: Hotels in the signed-in organization. Addresses, phone numbers, channel credentials, payment configuration, reminder configuration and guest data are excluded.

page.description: hasMore is true when another page exists; request it with offset + limit

title: List your hotels

description: Use this when someone asks how many towels, sheets, toiletries or other supplies the hotel has left in stock, or what is running low. Returns up to 100 stock items with unit, quantity, minimum and a low-stock flag. Not for rooms available to book.

hotelId.description: Id of the hotel, from list_hotels. Leave it out when the account has one hotel.

lowStockOnly.description: Only items at or below their minimum quantity.

search.description: Only items whose name contains these words.

name: list_inventory_items
title: Check hotel stock

annotations.title: List rate plans and base prices

description: Use this when someone asks what rate plans a hotel sells, such as room-only or breakfast-included rates, and their base prices. Returns each plan's title, room type, base price in minor currency units, meal plan, per-room or per-person pricing and default flag, 20 per page by default. Not for prices on specific dates.

limit.description: Rate plans per page, from 1 to 100; defaults to 20

offset.description: Rate plans to skip, from 0 to 10000; defaults to 0. For the next page pass offset + limit

roomTypeId.description: Only this room type (24 lowercase hexadecimal characters)

name: list_rate_plans

page.description: hasMore is true when another page exists; request it with offset + limit

ratePlans.description: basePrice is in integer minor currency units. Channel-manager mappings, integration metadata and credentials are excluded.

title: List rate plans and base prices

description: Use this when someone asks what kinds of rooms a hotel offers or how many guests each room type sleeps. Returns each room type's id, hotel, name and maximum guests, sorted by name, 20 per page by default. Not for whether a room type is free on given dates.

hotelId.description: Only this hotel (24 lowercase hexadecimal characters); every hotel when absent

limit.description: Room types per page, from 1 to 100; defaults to 20

offset.description: Room types to skip, from 0 to 10000; defaults to 0. For the next page pass offset + limit

name: list_room_types

page.description: hasMore is true when another page exists; request it with offset + limit

roomTypes.description: Room types sorted by name. Photos, public descriptions, rate-plan internals, channel mappings and credentials are excluded.

title: List room types

description: Use this when someone asks which rooms are clean, dirty or inspected, or which are out of order or out of service. Returns each physical room's name or number, room type and hotel with its room and housekeeping status, 20 per page by default (no guest or occupant data). Not for which rooms are free on given dates.

hotelId.description: Only this hotel (24 lowercase hexadecimal characters); every hotel when absent

limit.description: Rooms per page, from 1 to 100; defaults to 20

offset.description: Rooms to skip, from 0 to 10000; defaults to 0. For the next page pass offset + limit

roomTypeId.description: Only this room type (24 lowercase hexadecimal characters)

name: list_rooms

page.description: hasMore is true when another page exists; request it with offset + limit

rooms.description: Physical rooms sorted by name. Internal room ids, reservation, occupant, guest, access-control and channel data are excluded.

status.description: AVAILABLE (in service, not a statement about occupancy), OUT_OF_ORDER or OUT_OF_SERVICE

title: Check room and housekeeping status

description: Use this when someone asks to correct or update how much of a supply the hotel has in stock, such as after counting towels or receiving a delivery. Returns the item with its previous and new quantity; the number given replaces the stored one. Not for adding a new stock item.

expectedLastEditTime.description: The lastEditTime from list_inventory_items. An item changed since then is refused.

inventoryItemId.description: Id of the stock item, from list_inventory_items.

quantity.description: The quantity now in stock, in the item unit. It replaces the stored quantity; work out the total first when the user gives a change.

name: set_inventory_quantity
title: Update a stock quantity

description: Use this when someone wants a quick overview or dashboard of one hotel's operations. Returns an overview card with the hotel's details, reservation status counts for the next 7 days, and room, room-type, room-status and housekeeping counts from bounded samples (no guest, stay or payment data). Not for a single reservation.
name: show_hotel_overview

hotel.description: Null when not found. Guest identities, contact details, reservation or allocation identifiers, individual stay records, notes, documents, occupant ids, payments, access data, integration configuration, credentials and arbitrary metadata are excluded.

reservations.description: Reservations overlapping the next seven UTC days, any status, sampled up to 50; hasMore marks a lower bound

roomTypes.description: Room types, sampled up to 50; hasMore marks a lower bound

rooms.description: Physical rooms, sampled up to 100; hasMore marks a lower bound

title: Show hotel operations overview
